findings.evidence: Every ingredient is already generic in the carrier: `Representation.tensorPower` (TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Tensor/Power.lean:100), `Representation.symmetricPower` (SymmetricPower.lean:46), `Representation.exteriorPower` (ExteriorPower.lean:49), `SymmetricPower.range_mk` (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/TensorPower/Symmetric.lean:132), `exteriorPower.fromTensorPower_surjective` and `exteriorPower.map_comp_fromTensorPower` (TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/ExteriorPower.lean:162,218), `Basis.piTensorProduct_repr_tprod_apply` (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/PiTensorProduct/Basis.lean:42). The general entry computation is also shorter: with a general basis `b` the chain ends at `LinearMap.toMatrix_apply`, dropping the `simp [Matrix.mulVec_single]` step (line 573) that only unfolds `stdRep`.
findings.fix: State `IsPolynomialRep.tensorPower {ρ : Representation ℂ (GL (Fin n) ℂ) W} (h : IsPolynomialRep ρ) (d : ℕ) : IsPolynomialRep (ρ.tensorPower d)` and likewise `.symmetricPower`, `.exteriorPower`; then `isPolynomialRep_tensorPowerRep n d := (isPolynomialRep_stdRep n).tensorPower d` and the other two are one-liners.
findings.issue: `isPolynomialRep_tensorPowerRep`, `isPolynomialRep_symPowerRep` and `isPolynomialRep_extPowerRep` are stated only for `stdRep`, while the neighbouring closure results (`IsPolynomialRep.tprod`, `IsPolynomialRep.of_surjective`) are for an arbitrary `ρ`. The natural level is closure of the property under the functorial powers.

findings.evidence: `TensorProduct.toMatrix_map` is stated over `variable [CommRing R]` (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/TensorProduct/Matrix.lean:29,39); `Representation.tprod` is CommSemiring-level. The sibling section already proves its entry lemma for an arbitrary `Subalgebra k (G → k)` (lines 317, 352).
findings.fix: Move it into the `BasisChange` section over `{k : Type u} [CommRing k] {G} [Monoid G]` and state the subalgebra-generic form `toMatrix_tensorProduct_mem (A : Subalgebra k (G → k)) (b : Basis ι k W) (c : Basis κ k V) (h₁ : ∀ p l, (fun g => toMatrix b b (ρ g) p l) ∈ A) (h₂ : ∀ p l, (fun g => toMatrix c c (σ g) p l) ∈ A) (i j : ι × κ) : (fun g => toMatrix (b.tensorProduct c) (b.tensorProduct c) ((ρ.tprod σ) g) i j) ∈ A`, mirroring `toMatrix_mem_of_toMatrix_mem_of_surjective`; both `tprod` lemmas then reduce to two lines.
findings.issue: `toMatrix_tprod` is fixed to `ℂ` and `GL (Fin n) ℂ` although it is a pure `TensorProduct.toMatrix_map` fact valid over any commutative ring and monoid, and it is not lifted to the subalgebra level, so `IsPolynomialRep.tprod` (519) and `IsRationalRep.tprod` (533) repeat the same `hentry` block verbatim.

findings.evidence: Proof body (lines 257-265): `hne`/`eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀` are only the step converting the multiplicative identity to the inverse form; the substantive rewrite `← mul_assoc, ← pow_add` plus `omega` from `hle : m i ≤ Finset.univ.sup m` is field-free, exactly as in `rationalFunctions`' own `add_mem'` (lines 174-179) which is proved over `CommRing`.
findings.fix: State the CommRing form in the `CommRing` section — `∃ (P : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin n) k) (m : ℕ), ∀ i g, (g : Matrix _ _ k).det ^ m * f i g = entryEval g (P i)` — and derive the current `⁻¹` version over a field from it via `mem_rationalFunctions_iff_inv`.
findings.issue: `exists_forall_eq_inv_mul_of_forall_mem` sits in the `Field` section, but its content — the `Finset.univ.sup m` common-denominator trick — needs no field; the hypothesis is used only to divide back into the `(det ^ m)⁻¹` presentation. This contradicts the file's own stated rationale for keeping `rationalFunctions` multiplicative over a `CommRing` (lines 47-51).

summary: The subalgebra-level machinery is at the right level, but the functorial-power results are proved only for stdRep although the file already proves the binary tprod closure for an arbitrary representation, the tensor-product entry lemma is pinned to ℂ instead of matching its neighbouring subalgebra-generic lemma, and the common-denominator lemma carries a Field hypothesis its content does not use.
